summary: Produced a compilable TikZ reconstruction (version 2, best version). It draws the solid diameter A–O–B, the solid line A–E–C–P along AP, the solid line P–D–O along PO, the semicircular arc centred at O (radius 236 px) from A to B through C and D, dashed O–C and O–E, and a right-angle mark at E. All seven labels (A, B, C, D, E, O, P) are present. The Critic scored it 0.92 with no open issues, and the topology check passes. Version 1 had unnamed edges, which the topology repair fixed.
